perRecordPrice.projectionBasis: pooled independent per-record amounts: today's live wave entries + the 56 per-chunk amounts of the 2026-09-17 quote (surfaces/bpay-invoice.json lines[0].quotes[].amount_atto). low95/high95 = mean +/- 1.96 x sd/sqrt(n). The 2026-09-21 paid upload is the same file and is not pooled twice. The 4,146 B task-context quote has no per-record amounts and is not pooled.

impliedCloseRecordsStored.formula: paid per record = 3 x median quote (payment_policy.rs:9,63); quote = 0.00390625 + 0.03515625 x (n/6000)^2 ANT (ant-protocol 3.1.0 payment/pricing.rs:28,36,41,83); n solved from the paid amount

perRecordPrice.sizeIndependent: quote price depends only on the quoting node's stored-record count, not on chunk bytes (pricing.rs:83 takes close_records_stored only), so a 1-byte third of a tiny file costs the same as a full 4,190,208 B chunk

linearity.verdict: LINEAR in billable records (wave mode: records; merkle mode: power-of-two padded leaves per <=256 batch), with per-record noise of a few percent from which nodes answer. Not linear in bytes below 3 chunks (3 data records minimum) and stepwise at merkle padding.
linearity.model: records = dataChunks + (dataChunks > 3 ? 3 : 0) + 1; dataChunks = max(3, ceil(bytes / 4,190,208)). Checked: 214,091,829 B -> 52 + 3 + 1 = 56 = both 214 MB receipts; live runs compare recordsReportedByKit to recordsPredictedByChunkModel in browserQuotes.

projectionAssumptions: network price level stays where it was 2026-09-17 .. 2026-10-05: central/low/high = pooled per-record mean and its 95% band (perRecordPrice.projectionPerRecordANT); runLevelLow/High = lowest/highest per-run mean of any evidence point (small runs, very wide); medianBased = pooled median, the better guide for merkle batches because each batch is billed 3 x median16 of one 16-node pool
records(bytes) chunk model above (shrink_data_map adds 3 child chunks once; a second shrink level would add 3 more, negligible)

Auto mode pays merkle for >= 64 records: per batch of <= 256 leaves the vault charges 3 x median16 x 2^depth (merkle.rs:143-170; evmlib 0.10.0 lib.rs:206-226), so a non-power-of-two last batch is billed up to 2x its records; the browser shows the merkle maximum across candidate pools ("up to"), the paid amount can be lower

quoted prices rise quadratically as close-group nodes fill (pricing.rs:83); 10 GB adds ~2,391 records x 7 replicas (CLOSE_GROUP_SIZE 7, ant-protocol chunk.rs:125) to the network, effect on n UNVERIFIED (network size unknown here)
